name: Simon the Leper
background: Once an outcast, now a host. His house in Bethany became a refuge for Jesus and a place where the preparation for His burial began through Mary's anointing.

genericReactions.physical: This reminds me of the anointing oil. A beautiful, costly thing.
genericReactions.testimonial: I was an outcast. He made me clean. My house is His.
genericReactions.digital: The priests have their records of the unclean. I am no longer on that list.
genericReactions.environmental: My home in Bethany is a place of refuge for Him. All I have is His.
genericReactions.analytical: How can you measure the value of a new life? It is priceless.
genericReactions.prophecy: He said the woman who anointed him would be remembered. He is a true prophet.
